title: Strict unimodality conjecture for the V-statistics
statement:
Let $V(m,n)$ and $V_d(m,n)$ be the coefficients of the bivariate formal series $\mathcal{V}(z,q)$ and $\mathcal{V}_d(z,q)$, respectively, and let $\mathscr{U}_{z,q}^1$ denote the paper's one-variable coefficientwise unimodality class. **Strict unimodality conjecture for the V-statistics.** Both series satisfy

$$
\mathcal{V}(z,q),\mathcal{V}_d(z,q)\in\mathscr{U}_{z,q}^1.
$$
 Equivalently, for all integers $m,n\ge 0$,

$$
V(m,n)\ge V(m+1,n)\qquad\text{and}\qquad V_d(m,n)\ge V_d(m+1,n).
$$
 The claim is supported by numerical verification for $n\le 50$; the paper presents it as a stronger conjecture concerning these two series.
references:
Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2408.04433

Status: no resolution is reported in the source (as of August 2024).
source_name: Nian Hong Zhou, “Unimodality and certain bivariate formal Laurent series”, arXiv:2408.04433 (2025).
